title: Americans on AI (synthetic development example)
methodology_notes:
FABRICATED DATA. This study is a synthetic example used for IRIS pipeline development. The questionnaire shape ("Americans on AI", americanson.ai) is real; subgroup categories, sample sizes, and all reported percentages were invented to be directionally plausible but do not reflect any real fielding.

Mode: online probability panel. Weights raked to ACS / CPS benchmarks on age, gender, education, race/ethnicity, region, and party. Every published percentage in this file is reported under base.kind="all" (non-substantive responses kept in the denominator). Grid items are randomized within respondent on Q1, Q3, Q4, Q5, and Q6.
